Skills to learn assigned applications and meet proficiency testing requirements, and to maintain certification in assigned applications.
Bachelor's degree in information technology, Healthcare, or equivalent or a combination of experience, education or training.
Experience implementing and supporting electronic medical record systems.
Experience with professional billing and claims in Epic with SBO
Experience with professional revenue and billing including Coding, Claims, Self-pay, Follow-up, payment posting and credit resolution.
Academic institution or large integrated health system experience.
Experience working with clinical information systems or system implementation teams for complex projects and/or application development.
Experience working with interfaced/integrated multi-vendor applications.
Knowledge of quality tools and experience in business or clinical process improvement initiatives.
Skills or experience demonstrating advanced application of adult learning principles and system design standards.
Experience demonstrating knowledge of business operations and end-user requirements to improve or develop system design and training projects.

Under the supervision of the Billing System Support Manager, this experienced Applications Liaison professional and technical leader performs a variety of duties relating to the Revenue Cycle Information Systems applications. As a technical leader in Professional Billing pic Resolute applications, applies advanced professional concepts and extensive industry knowledge to lead and / or work on medium to large projects of broad scope and complexity. Responsibilities include: Leading and assisting with process development, analysis, testing, implementation, and support of information systems for the organization; Project management, planning, development, testing, implementation, and evaluation of application functionality. Works with the team and key customers to ensure appropriate development, testing, training, and implementation of application functionality.
30% - Project Management, SME Implementation and Revenue Integrity Support

This position will be primarily responsible for Epic Resolute Professional billing application as the technical leader for gathering business requirements, support, and maintenance. As a technical leader, may manage programs that include formulating strategies and administering policies, processes and resources. The leader functions with a high degree of autonomy.
30% - System Analysis – Implementation and Support

The Resolute Billing liaison will assist the clinical departments, billing departments and information technology partners (IT leadership, clinical chairs and department staff) to support the department’s Revenue Cycle Information Systems applications. The Liaison will prioritize all incoming project work in alignment to the greatest financial impact to the organization. The liaison will partner with project teams and departments to prepare cash flow worksheets, requirements and project plans and will assist in the management of projects from design to deployment.
Participation in an implementation of an activity or strategy in a department, clinic or system environment.
Strong customer service orientation.
Broadly encompassing or highly in-depth knowledge of 1-2 areas of focus in clinical applications specialty area(s) related to revenue cycle.
Advanced organizational and project management skills, and ability to lead a team, prioritize tasks, and see projects through from inception to completion on schedule.

Knowledge of operations, systems and functions, including planning, design, development, implementation, user support and training, maintenance, quality assurance, and system testing and evaluation supporting healthcare revenue cycle.
Knowledge and understanding of University policies and procedures.
Knowledge of insurance claim processing and third-party reimbursement

Advanced interpersonal communication skills to effectively train, support, and collaborate productively with clinical and revenue cycle users, and key stakeholders at all professional and technical levels.

Organizational skills to independently prioritize workload and meet deadlines develop and carry out project assignments in efficient and timely manner, and to provide accurate and succinct documentation of activities.
Ability to react with flexibility and patience and maintain efficiency and accuracy under sustained and immediate pressure created by heavy workload, frequent interruptions and multiple requests.
Ability to apply advanced problem-resolution skills to highly complex issues, quickly diagnose problems, and develop, test and implement appropriate and effective solutions in a timely manner.

Advanced written and verbal communications skills, to convey highly-technical information and instructions to all levels of clinical and revenue cycle users and staff in a specific, clear, and concise manner.

Advanced ability to serve as a technical leader and information resource, and to work collaboratively with key personnel and management, providing guidance and recommendations on systems, improvements, upgrades, and industry advances and trends.
Proficient in office automation software (word processing, spreadsheets, visual presentation, etc.)
